description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to find references/search-params.md for full parameter docs. (2) Discover that conf.json uses a UNIFIED timelimit format ('month') that differs from the native Zhipu values ('oneMonth') and native DDGS values ('m') shown in conf.json.example — copying the example directly will fail. (3) Select 'search_pro_sogou' as the search_engine and recognize the constraint that count for this engine must be in [10,20,30,40,50] — so 20 is correct and must not be changed to an arbitrary number. (4) Set content_size to 'medium' for compact summaries. (5) Set region to 'cn-zh' for Chinese-language DuckDuckGo results. (6) Combine two backends as a comma-separated string: 'bing,google'. (7) Set search_domain_filter to null. (8) Set apiKey to 'ZHIPU_SEARCH_API_KEY'. The proprietary traps are: the unified timelimit format (vs. native values in the corrupted example), the search_pro_sogou count constraint, and the comma-separated multi-backend syntax.
